## Description

Applies sparse Bayesian learning and automatic relevance determination (ARD) priors to dynamic factor models to automatically select active alpha factors and eliminate redundant noise.

## Where it may fit

High-dimensional factor investing, feature selection in multi-factor stock models, systematic equity screening.

## Vehicles

Systematic equity funds, quantitative multi-factor investment managers.

## Required data

Broad fundamental and technical factor matrices, stock return panels, point-in-time financial statements.

## Caveats

MCMC sampling for hierarchical Bayesian models can be computationally intensive for large factor sets.
